_note: Undead text (draugr, skeletons, dragon priests) for every source without its own file in this folder: dry leathery or rotted flesh, old bone, grave dust, cold blue eye-light; no blood, no breath, no bodily fluids. Undead feel no pain as the living do: feels describe failing strength and the cold will that drives them. Shared keys first, then the block of the source's model (health / torture). Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.
